candidates.name: Rank-only quantitative diffraction under unknown detector response
candidates.distinct_from_occupied_families: New measurement proposal; not the existing microscopy coordinate-transfer or manufacturing-check experiments.
candidates.beneficiary: Operators measuring fragile or transient samples where intensity-only sensing loses complex-field information.
candidates.what_changed_now: The retrieved 2025 open-problem synthesis and 2026 snapshot instruments make narrowly scoped instrument design timely. Frontier-model assistance may accelerate mathematical exploration, but no measured AGI advantage or newly crossed hardware threshold was established.
candidates.commercial_evidence: No buyer validation, price estimate, cost model, or profitability result established; do not import prior-study revenue.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Source-linked problem statements, executable ambiguity witnesses, and explicit scope tests. Ordinary files/library provide the same information; no retained Alpha established.
candidates.valuable_outcome: Recover a calibrated complex field from intensity comparisons despite an unknown detector transfer curve, enabling quantitative transient or dose-limited measurements.
candidates.initial_connection: Replace detector-value calibration with order relations between coded diffraction channels, seeking a measurement primitive robust to response drift.
candidates.strongest_prior_art: S1 already constructs one-bit paired coded-diffraction recovery with unknown rank-preserving distortions, and explicitly treats super-resolution and blind deconvolution.
candidates.specific_unmet_boundary: Rank data alone discard absolute amplitude; unknown non-rank-preserving response is outside the directly claimed invariance. Neither boundary was solved here.
candidates.construction_needed: A physically specified new observable that resolves scale or non-monotone ambiguity under the same dose, exposure, and calibration constraints; a generic known-reference channel is already holographic prior art (S5).

smallest_decisive_test.scope: Eight-dimensional complex objects, 64 paired coded measurements, unknown monotone response; require both phase (modulo one global phase) and absolute power.
smallest_decisive_test.control: S1-style ordinal measurement with identical masks and measurement budget.
smallest_decisive_test.acceptance: Prove injectivity for the added observable in the stated class, execute held-out reconstruction under noise, and demonstrate a useful outcome the equally informed control cannot achieve.
smallest_decisive_test.falsifier: Two physically distinct admissible signals produce identical data, or ordinary holography provides the same capability at equal resource constraints.

candidates.executed_probe: discovery_targeted_probe_results.json#rank_scale: x and 2x yield all 64 identical ordinal bits while power differs fourfold.
candidates.failure_reason: The generic invention is direct prior art; the quantitative extension is nonidentifiable with the proposed data. Scale-normalizing the task would weaken its original useful purpose.
candidates.commercial_mechanism_if_solved: Instrument IP or a qualified reconstruction module priced against the value of otherwise unattainable measurements; this is a hypothesis, not demand evidence.

candidates.name: Direct complex-field reconstruction under irregular, damage-constrained scan access
candidates.distinct_from_occupied_families: Concerns creation of an imaging observable/inversion capability, not transfer of an existing microscopy workflow.
candidates.beneficiary: Operators measuring fragile or transient samples where intensity-only sensing loses complex-field information.
candidates.what_changed_now: The retrieved 2025 open-problem synthesis and 2026 snapshot instruments make narrowly scoped instrument design timely. Frontier-model assistance may accelerate mathematical exploration, but no measured AGI advantage or newly crossed hardware threshold was established.
candidates.commercial_evidence: No buyer validation, price estimate, cost model, or profitability result established; do not import prior-study revenue.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Source-linked problem statements, executable ambiguity witnesses, and explicit scope tests. Ordinary files/library provide the same information; no retained Alpha established.
candidates.valuable_outcome: Recover a globally coherent quantitative image when motion or sample damage prevents a regular scan and rules out acquisition of missing positions.
candidates.initial_connection: Treat the allowed physical scan geometry as part of the measurement instrument; seek an explicit nonuniform deconvolution identity with stated identifiability and stability conditions rather than interpolating unmeasured data.
candidates.strongest_prior_art: S2 Q8.5 identifies an arbitrary-scan WDD formula as open; S3 already supports live WDD, and S4 already reconstructs randomly subsampled low-dose acquisitions. Therefore a new fast solver, sparse scan, or live display is insufficient.
candidates.specific_unmet_boundary: An explicit finite nonuniform WDD identity with rigorous recovery/stability conditions is a literature-defined research gap. It is not yet evidence of a useful outcome unavailable to iterative ptychography or existing compressed-sensing reconstruction.
candidates.construction_needed: Derive a valid nonuniform measurement factorization and reconstruction theorem; specify known versus unknown probe, object class, overlap connectivity, position errors, noise, and dose. Then show why it enables a preserved useful purpose beyond all identified controls, not just a different solver.

smallest_decisive_test.scope: Begin with 16-64 complex object samples and a known compact probe; enumerate irregular position sets including connected, disconnected, missing-region, and noisy cases.
controls: Direct full/regular-grid WDD on feasible comparable acquisitions
S4-style inpainting plus reconstruction with identical data
Strong iterative phase-retrieval baseline with identical data and priors
Conventional lifted linear-algebra solution where tractable
smallest_decisive_test.acceptance: A proved identifiable regime and executed held-out accepted output that the admissible strong controls cannot produce under the same physical restrictions. Any solely runtime or ordinary numerical advantage fails the requested flagship criterion.
smallest_decisive_test.falsifier: An exact ambiguous pair remains admissible, a hidden prior supplies the missing information, extra dose/measurement authority is required, or existing methods yield the same useful output.

candidates.executed_probe: discovery_targeted_probe_results.json#disconnected_scans: 96 exact intensities agree for two known-support objects with relative component phase reversed; best global-phase-aligned relative error is sqrt(2).
candidates.failure_reason: The proposed new capability has not been constructed. Local overlap is insufficient without global information; no theorem resolves the gap, and existing live/subsampled methods already cover the generic beneficiary claim. Q8.5 is a targeted mathematical follow-on, not an achieved discovery.
candidates.commercial_mechanism_if_solved: Module licensing or measurement services for users with independently demonstrated scan-access constraints. Compare human-led instrument R&D rather than invent an existing-service market price.

selection.decision: No flagship from this targeted pass.
selection.reason: T1 is anticipated and its proposed quantitative extension is nonidentifiable. T2 exposes an explicit mathematical question but no substantive new construction or uniquely enabled useful outcome was established.
selection.recommended_next_step: Only pursue T2 after a narrow original theorem/measurement construction can be stated and compared with strong iterative and compressed-sensing controls. Do not commission a full paper or pricing simulation around the generic idea.
